instruction: Candid photographic medium shot in a boxing gym. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1) holds a black punching bag steady, looking attentively at his partner. On the right, the blonde woman in the purple cropped hoodie (R2) stands in a ready stance, facing the bag. The background is a gray concrete wall with a boxing silhouette. Soft overhead lighting illuminates the scene.
